hypothesis: Recent bad trades cluster in reproducible hold-quality or follow-through failure families.
backtest_protocol: Observed-only rerun of BacktestEngine.run over the three docs/backtesting.md fixed windows with canonical OHLCV snapshots; no strategy logic, filters, thresholds, or production files changed.

accepted_artifact_context.note: This script recomputes trade-level records from the current working tree and fixed snapshots because the latest accepted three-window metric artifact does not store every closed trade.

historical_rejected_constraints: Low-MFE stopout replay was rejected in exp-20260426-053.
Early-adverse/no-reclaim exit replay was rejected in exp-20260508-035.
Near-target giveback and overnight-gap audits showed high winner collateral.
This artifact is diagnostic only and must not be treated as a filter.

early_adverse_no_reclaim.definition: first 3 trading days MAE <= -3% and first 3 day MFE < 2%

weak_follow_through.definition: first 3 trading day close return <= 0 and first 3 day MFE < 2%

gain_then_failed_hold.definition: full-trade MFE >= 3%; bad slice is trades that still closed negative

addon_loss.definition: trade had addon_count > 0; bad slice is trades that closed negative

rs20_sized_loss.definition: trade had rs20_entry_state sizing tag; bad slice is trades that closed negative
